items.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
items.sum: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

items.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
items.sum: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
items.sum: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

items.title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
items.sum: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools.

items.title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report
items.sum: Bitcoin hovered near $75,000 after a wave of liquidations, with Tuesday's inflation report set to test bets on a December Fed rate hike.

items.title: Elizabeth Warren vows scrutiny of prediction markets, Trump family crypto ventures as Senate Banking chair
items.sum: Sen. Elizabeth Warren is setting her sights on prediction market oversight and the Trump family's burgeoning crypto businesses.

items.title: Binance hack launderers mint homemade Elon Musk, animal memecoins to move stolen funds: Elliptic
items.sum: Elliptic says the extra swaps slow investigators down, but the stolen funds remain traceable onchain.

items.title: Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide
items.sum: Europe's largest asset manager raised its Strategy holding to 1.9 million shares.

items.title: North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot
items.sum: Elliptic says North Korean launderers created six throwaway meme tokens on NEAR.

items.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX-ICE platform even as most companies opt out
items.sum: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines.
